data.name: Standard Gas/Carbon Char Store
data.description: London-based Standard Gas Technologies is commercialising its carbon-negative energy-from-waste SG100 technology and has launched Carbon Char Store as its carbon removals sales and marketing arm. The patented SG100 generates clean renewable energy plus carbon-capturing biochar, and provides an alternative to landfill and incineration. Biochar is a co-product (~10-15% of output) sequestered in soil and construction aggregates.
